author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹಣಗಳಿಕೆ ಗುರಿಯಾಗೆ ಜೀವನದಿ ಬಹುಜನಕೆ
ಗುಣ ನಡತೆ ಋಣಗಳನು ಮರೆತು ನಡೆಯುವರು
ಮಣಭಾರ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳ ತಿದ್ದದೆಯೆ ಸರಿಯೆನಲು
ಹೆಣವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕುವರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When earning money is the goal of life for many,
they walk on forgetting virtue, conduct and their debts;
claiming a heavy load of mistakes is right without correcting them,
they live on as corpses, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: When money becomes everything, people forget character and the debts they owe to others. Justifying mistakes instead of correcting them leaves a person alive only in name.
